lines.3: 「Nobody asked you, you surly little first-year! Go shake people down with a razor blade like a good girl.」
lines.4: 「You sure do squawk a lot for an upperclassman.」
lines.5: Nagomi gave Kinu's cheek a sharp tug.
lines.9: 「Hey, Yashi. Doing that in the middle of the street... People are staring.」
lines.11: 「Tch. I have no interest in being mistaken for a bully.」
lines.13: Nagomi glanced back as she spoke.
lines.14: Her black hair fluttering in the wind, Nagomi walked away.
lines.15: 「Did you really think I'd let you get away, moron?!」
lines.19: 「Heh heh. Listen to that girly yelp. You like a swat on the butt?」
lines.20: Kinu had pulled a daikon from her bag and smacked Nagomi across the seat of her jeans with all her might.
lines.21: 「Your upperclassman just gave a cocky first-year a motivational butt-batting. You oughta thank me.」
lines.22: Kinu tapped the daikon against her own shoulder.
lines.23: 「I'll make you cry. I swear I'll make you cry.」
lines.24: 「Bring it! Next time I'll shove a carrot in your mouth and call you Bunny!」
lines.26: Honestly. It was hot out, and they still had all that energy.
lines.28: 「Hah, hah... It was a draw... That first-year has guts. Nobody normal ends with a headbutt...」
lines.29: 「Sounds like one hell of a fight.」
lines.30: Maybe they were worthy rivals after all.
